name: Landhaus Enzian
beschreibung: The Landhaus Enzian is a traditional inn in a small village in the Tiroler Unterland. The building is built in regional style, with wooden furniture and a cozy dining room. Tiroler Spezialitäten are prepared here according to traditional homemade recipes. The house is quietly located on the edge of the village, surrounded by meadows and mountains. Guests can expect simple, clean rooms as well as good regional cuisine at fair prices.
